statement: AMD's Helios rack-scale system reached full production status with Q3 2026 shipment start and ramp into H2 2027.
why: A dated production and shipment schedule turns announced gigawatt commitments into an actual supply timeline the market can plan around.

impact.mechanism: Full production status with a near-term shipment start adds a second rack-scale accelerator supply line, pulling through memory, rack and cooling supply chains.

evidence.source: ServeTheHome (AMD Advancing AI 2026 Keynote Live Coverage)
evidence.excerpt: announced as reaching "full production status"; "Q3 2026 shipment start; ramping into H2 2027"

confidence.basis: Secondary live-blog coverage of a vendor keynote; no primary filing fetched and no multi-publisher corroboration in this document.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: magnitude 2 -> 3; sources: AMD Investor Relations (ir.amd.com), ServeTheHome (AMD Advancing AI 2026 Keynote Live Coverage)
